candidate_081.name: advisory adaptive governance under deterministic promotion authority

published_claim.source: arXiv:2606.03321v1, Validation-Gated Multi-Agent Governance for Online Adaptation of Thermal-Hydraulic Surrogate Models under Operating-Regime Shift, submitted 2026-06-02
published_claim.supported_scope: Two held-out thermal-hydraulic stream transients, three seeds per mode, seven operating modes. All adaptive modes use the same deterministic safety envelope. MA-Full has the lowest reported mean MAE (5.72 versus Static 7.06 and Rule-H 6.54) and warning-exceedance ratio 35.8% versus Static 56.8%; paired bootstrap intervals against Static exclude zero, while intervals among adaptive modes overlap and the paper explicitly limits broad claims to six paired units.
published_claim.promotion_evidence: The paper reports a representative temporal-FNO to Transformer validation change 8.60 to 5.64, then Transformer to GNN 4.74 to 3.16, and 13 validated champion transitions overall (8 to GNN-family, 5 to Transformer-family).

confirmed: Deterministic promotion authority is explicit: agents advise, while validation, clipping, promotion and rollback gates remain authoritative.
The hard gate requires mean-MAE gain >=0.02 with no regression in exceedance, RMSE, p95, tail-mean or clipping; rollback triggers on non-finite predictions or excessive clipping.
Two held-out streams contain 2701 and 3185 windows and are restarted from the same pretrained champion.
The paper supplies protocol thresholds and aggregate result tables.
missing_for_exact_replay: No author-linked runnable repository or immutable implementation was recovered.
Experimental TH data are not public-download artifacts; the paper says they are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request subject to review.
No raw per-unit six-pair result table, seeds, model checkpoints, agent transcripts, promotion logs or environment lock were recovered.

candidate_081.independent_replication: No protocol-matched third-party reproduction or failure report was recovered in this audit.
candidate_081.failed_replication: None recovered; absence is not evidence of successful replication.
scope_corrections: The strong reproducible mechanism claim is deterministic-gated adaptive model evolution, not causal superiority of multi-agent governance.

MA-Full versus Rule-H does not isolate a single multi-agent treatment: MA-Full includes background shadow refresh and stepwise five-role review, while Rule-H is rule-only. The paper itself notes overlapping adaptive-mode intervals and calls for stronger ablations/baselines.

The six paired units are two fixed physical stream transcripts crossed with three algorithmic seeds. They support fixed-stream/seed uncertainty but are not six independent operating-regime realizations; do not generalize the bootstrap result to arbitrary future physical regimes.
candidate_081.reopen_on: Author code/data/checkpoints/raw six-unit outputs, immutable environment/agent configuration, matched independent rerun, or a randomized live-lab ablation that isolates deterministic gating from agent-governance effects.

candidate_082.name: low-bandwidth validation feedback plus fresh-reproducer certificate

published_claim.source: arXiv:2606.11045v1, What Fits (Into Few Tokens) Doesn't Overfit: Compression and Generalization in ML Research Agents, submitted 2026-06-09
published_claim.supported_scope: Eight ML tasks. Under score feedback, 32-token reproducers pass the paper's one-sided 5% relative-gap rule on 38/41 improvement checkpoints. In separate three-run-per-condition input-compression experiments, one-bit ladder feedback reaches comparable or identical final holdout performance to scalar feedback across all eight datasets. In a deliberately aggressive full-validation-access stress test, a 128-token reproduction failure rule flags 38/38 checkpoints labeled overfitting and 6/64 checkpoints labeled non-overfitting.

official_artifact_support.strength: detailed paper protocol and prompt templates; no recovered runnable experiment release
confirmed: The reproducer is mechanically isolated from validation files/API and receives only training data plus the compressed prompt.
The paper publishes explorer/compressor/reproducer prompt templates, access-control rules, dataset split sizes and numerical summary tables.

The ladder theorem directly controls the explorer's population performance at realized improvement checkpoints under its stated assumptions; the paper explicitly says output compression only certifies the reproducer hypothesis.
missing_for_exact_replay: No author-linked immutable experiment harness repository, raw explorer/compressor/reproducer trajectories, exact checkpoint bundle or run manifest was recovered.
The paper specifies Claude Opus through Claude Code but does not identify an immutable model snapshot/build or Claude Code version sufficient for exact historical agent replay.
No protocol-matched external reproduction/failure report was recovered.

candidate_082.independent_replication: The paper's fresh reproducer agents are experimental components inside the primary study, not independent third-party replications.
candidate_082.failed_replication: The 128-token failures are deliberate within-study stress-test outcomes under full validation access, not failed independent replications of the paper.
scope_corrections: The 100% sensitivity / 91% specificity result is descriptive for one deliberately overfitting stress protocol and its 102 checkpoints; it is not a universal validation-exploitation detector guarantee.
Checkpoints are nested within tasks/runs, so the 102 rows should not be silently treated as iid evidence for population detector error rates.

The validation-quarantine use proposed by the clean worker is an O-specific/downstream adaptation. The paper tests ML research-agent harnesses, not autonomous physical science or preservation of scientific discovery yield.
candidate_082.reopen_on: Official harness/raw trajectories/exact agent-version manifest, protocol-matched external rerun, new post-training-cutoff datasets that close contamination concerns, or a science-domain controlled validation-quarantine experiment.
